summary.en:
- Sparkle is a Harmony support who generates a large amount of Skill Points for the team.
- Her Skill advances a single ally by 50%. To maximize this action advance, it is generally best to pair a fast Sparkle with a base SPD DPS.
- Her Ultimate provides six Skill Points for the team. Any excessive Skill Points will be stored with a limit of 10.
- Sparkle's large Skill Point generation makes her a core support for Archer. Combined with her strong general buffs, she is also an excellent support in a wide variety of teams.

details.en:
- E2 provides additional Def Ignore to her Talent.
- E1 provides herself a speed buff and an additional ATK% buff for her Ultimate.
- S1 [[light-cone:earthly-escapade]] provides teamwide CRIT buffs. However, other options such as [[light-cone:ddd]], [[light-cone:a-grounded-ascent]], or even [[light-cone:psim]] can perform similarly or, in some situations, outperform her signature Light Cone.
